Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when its done.
94411-accept.title: Meddlesome Mages

94411-complete.name: Illaya Amberwind
94411-complete.text:
Direct conflict with our shen'dorei brothers and sisters only weakens us as a people, but decisive action must at times be taken to prevent greater tragedy.

The mages of the High Order have zero regard for the consequences of their magical meddling. The forces that bind our island are fragile and vulnerable and all it could take is one thoughtless action to destroy our home.
94411-complete.title: Meddlesome Mages

94414-accept.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
94414-accept.text:
Greetings, young $N. I often times come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
94414-accept.title: The Anchors of Zephras

94414-complete.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
94414-complete.text: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.
94414-complete.title: The Anchors of Zephras

94484-accept.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
94484-accept.text:
A moment, if you will $N. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able go, seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
94484-accept.title: Unnerving Silence

94484-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94484-complete.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94484-complete.title: Unnerving Silence

94485-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94485-accept.text:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
94485-accept.title: Tears of the Lady

94485-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94485-complete.text:
<Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.>

Thank you, $N, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.
94485-complete.title: Tears of the Lady

94485-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94485-progress.text: Have you found the Lady's Tear?
94485-progress.title: Tears of the Lady

94486-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94486-accept.text:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486-accept.title: Feathers for Binding

94486-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94486-complete.text: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.
94486-complete.title: Feathers for Binding

94486-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94486-progress.text: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.
94486-progress.title: Feathers for Binding

94487-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-accept.text:
The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds in-between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487-accept.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94487-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-complete.text:
<Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.>

So many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, $c.

I will hold onto them for safe keeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.
94487-complete.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94487-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-progress.text: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.
94487-progress.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94488-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94488-accept.text:
The reason for cultists presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
94488-accept.title: The Ties That Bind

94488-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94488-complete.text:
<Elegael grimaces at the severed head, but nods curtly.>

Thank you, $N. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin.

Do not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.
94488-complete.title: The Ties That Bind

94488-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94488-progress.text: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?
94488-progress.title: The Ties That Bind

94489-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94489-accept.text:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
94489-accept.title: The Wounds of Betrayal

94489-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94489-complete.text:
<Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>

No... no! This is far worse than I had--

<Elegael chokes back a sob, and grits her teeth letting out a pained snarl.>

They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.
94489-complete.title: The Wounds of Betrayal

94490-accept.name: Unknown
94490-accept.text: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information for about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>
94490-accept.title: Ripped Missive

94490-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94490-complete.text:
They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?

<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>

They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.

Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired.
94490-complete.title: Ripped Missive

94491-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94491-accept.text:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, thought the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, $N. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
94491-accept.title: The Fate of the Den

94491-complete.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
94491-complete.text:
<Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the druid den.>

I--I'm sorry, $N. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.

This is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows sacrifice be in vain.
94491-complete.title: The Fate of the Den

94568-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94568-accept.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of the what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
94568-accept.title: The Cult's True Plans

94568-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94568-complete.text:
We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.

We are going to need a different approach.
94568-complete.title: The Cult's True Plans

94896-accept.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94896-accept.text:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
94896-accept.title: Aid For The Refugees

94896-complete.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94896-complete.text: Thank you, $c, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.
94896-complete.title: Aid For The Refugees

94896-progress.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94896-progress.text: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.
94896-progress.title: Aid For The Refugees

94897-accept.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94897-accept.text:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
94897-accept.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94897-complete.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94897-complete.text:
<Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>

Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.

Thank you, $c. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.
94897-complete.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94897-progress.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94897-progress.text: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, $c, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.
94897-progress.title: The Fate of a Loved One

95349-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
95349-accept.text:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. 

Banu-Alah, $N.
95349-accept.title: The Earthen Ring

95805-accept.name: Seer Graytongue
95805-accept.text:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.

We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

Don't get it wet!
95805-accept.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95805-complete.name: Unknown
95805-complete.text: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>
95805-complete.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95805-progress.name: Unknown
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

96101-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96101-complete.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96101-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96130-accept.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-accept.text:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130-accept.title: Chakuyak

96130-complete.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-complete.text: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.
96130-complete.title: Chakuyak

96130-progress.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?
96130-progress.title: Chakuyak

96605-accept.text:

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

96605-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96638-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
96638-accept.text:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638-accept.title: The Adventurer

96646-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
96646-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96646-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96646-complete.name: Zerril Softbreeze
96646-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96646-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96658-complete.name: William Pickman
96658-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96658-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96659-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
96659-accept.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
96659-accept.title: The Adventurer

96659-complete.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-complete.text:
Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96659-complete.title: The Adventurer

96659-progress.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659-progress.title: The Adventurer

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96661-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97242-accept.name: Kor'geld
97242-accept.text:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242-accept.title: Yelmak's Medley

97243-accept.name: Sessaria Skystride
97243-accept.text:
Even though we are in the realm of skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
97243-accept.title: Call of Fire

97243-complete.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97243-complete.text: So you've brought the torch. Yes, young $c, I can teach you to heed the call of fire. It will not be easy, but nothing that we do in this realm is ever easy.
97243-complete.title: Call of Fire

97243-progress.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97243-progress.text: Yes, $N? What do you have there?
97243-progress.title: Call of Fire

97244-accept.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97244-accept.text:
There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of  his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.
97244-accept.title: Call of Fire

97244-complete.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97244-complete.text:
The Windshapers do not forget, and blood is always paid with blood. It pleases me that you were able to deliver this final, painful reminder of our creed to this traitor.

This heart will not be all that feeds the flames today, however. There is one other task that needs to done.
97244-complete.title: Call of Fire

97244-progress.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97244-progress.text: The heart of a betrayer is a powerful reagent. The flames will eagerly accept such an offering and burn more intensely as it is consumed.
97244-progress.title: Call of Fire

97245-accept.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97245-accept.text:
The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.

Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.

Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.
97245-accept.title: Call of Fire

97245-complete.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97245-complete.text: We now have what we need. We will light the eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire.
97245-complete.title: Call of Fire

97245-progress.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97245-progress.text: The spirit of Kuramaa is eternal, and it will manifest again when it is needed. It's mask is a source of great power, and will prove invaluable to the ritual we must complete.
97245-progress.title: Call of Fire

97257-accept.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97257-accept.text:
Now we will perform the ritual. 

I will place the materials onto the altar and call forth the spirits of flame. If the offering is accepted, they will appear and light the Eternal Flame. You will then hold your torch forth and capture the flame.

Carry the lit torch to Valanaar and place it in the Brazier of Eternal Flames. You must do so quickly, for the flames of the Firelands are quick to dissipate here in Skywall.
97257-accept.title: Call of Fire

97257-complete.name: Sessaria Skystride
97257-complete.text:
It is done. The Eternal Flame burns once again.

Your trial is now complete. I am pleased to present you with your Fire Totem. Use this icon of power well in your travels, $N. 

Just remember, the power of the elemental plane serves those that respect it, and consumes those who do not. This is our way.
97257-complete.title: Call of Fire

97257-progress.name: Sessaria Skystride
97257-progress.text: You have done well to come this far. You do the Windshapers honor, $N.
97257-progress.title: Call of Fire

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97485-complete.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-complete.text:
You have done well, friend.

I thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, $N. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.

Should you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.

Go with An'she's warmth.
97485-complete.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97485-progress.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-progress.text:
There are many occasions one may choose to spread incense to the winds. You could be asking the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or even to seek guidance from our ancestors.

Or it could be something else entirely.

Though the act is done with reverence, it is not strictly a ceremonial affair. Typically there are certain traditional steps observed when performing this act, but many tribes have differing practices.
97485-progress.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97558-progress.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-progress.text:
Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.

It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.

Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
97558-progress.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97934-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97934-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97934-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97934-complete.name: Chaw Stronghide
97934-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97934-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97936-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97936-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97936-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97963-accept.text:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.

97963-complete.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97965-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97965-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97965-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97967-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97967-accept.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97967-accept.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97968-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97968-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97968-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97968-complete.name: Syriel Nightrain
97968-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97968-complete.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

98430-accept.name: Perith Stormhoof
98430-accept.text:
Hail, $c. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.

All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.

Are you up to the task?
98430-accept.title: The Longwalkers

98430-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
98430-complete.text:
I am relieved that Longwalker Stormhoof is well. He is my most trusted scout, and his mission of the utmost importance.

Please, accept my thanks and my hospitality for riskng your life to save his own. You have done a greater service to our people than you know.

I encourage you to explore our great city while you are here. It is a place of safety, and you will find many that may aid you on your own travels upon its bluffs.

Ish-ne-alo por-ah.
98430-complete.title: The Longwalkers

98512-accept.name: Fendaal Windstone
98512-accept.text:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
98512-accept.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

98512-complete.name: Fendaal Windstone
98512-complete.text:
I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers. 

Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.
98512-complete.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

98512-progress.name: Fendaal Windstone
98512-progress.text: I wonder what they are after?
98512-progress.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

99079-accept.name: Brave Wildrunner
99079-accept.text:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079-accept.title: Longwalker Malah

99079-complete.name: Malah Longwind
99079-complete.text: It is clear that Malah did not die naturally. Arrows cover her back and the ground nearby.
99079-complete.title: Longwalker Malah

99080-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99080-accept.text:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
99080-accept.title: Drive Them Out

99081-accept.name: Malah Longwind
99081-accept.text:
You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore.

The Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.
99081-accept.title: Grim Tidings

99081-complete.name: Brave Wildrunner
99081-complete.text: This is most dire news indeed. We must inform Baine at once!
99081-complete.title: Grim Tidings

99101-accept.name: Brave Wildrunner
99101-accept.text:
Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.

Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.

Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!
99101-accept.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99101-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99101-complete.text:
<Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.>

This will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, $N.
99101-complete.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99101-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99101-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
99101-progress.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match

99108-complete.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-complete.text:
You honor me with your abilities, $c. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.

Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
99108-complete.title: Sparring Match

99144-accept.name: Bareth Dawnstone
99144-accept.text:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144-accept.title: Seeking Refuge

99144-complete.name: Shari Stilwell
99144-complete.text:
Blessings upon you for aiding Dawnstone. Our order is still taking root here and it would be devastating to lose one so promising before his time.

Please accept this as a token of our thanks. Should you ever take an interest in our ways, our monastery Bandarion Keep lies on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead. We welcome all who seek guidance in the Light.
99144-complete.title: Seeking Refuge

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
